status_contract.AUDITED_TRUE: The exact registered statement has hostile-audit PASS and may supply audited credit only within PROVES/DOES_NOT_PROVE.
status_contract.OPEN_GOAL: Stable unresolved target; authority_status is DECLARED_GOAL and supplies no mathematical credit.
status_contract.OPEN_BRANCH: Stable unresolved branch of the active carrier problem; supplies no closure credit.
status_contract.BLOCKED_OPEN_GOAL: Stable unresolved target with an explicit upstream blocker; supplies no mathematical credit.
status_contract.ACTIVE_INCOMPLETE: Active production target whose completion flag remains false; authorization or finite indexability is not completion.
